Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Rass Ordo]] undertook a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] to search for [[Greb Besrik]], a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] who worked for [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]]'s mercenary team.<ref name="Hoth Pursuit" />
